facts.text: The resort is at kilometre 19.5 of the Carretera Transpeninsular in San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur.
facts.excerpt: Carretera Transpeninsular km 19.5 San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur

facts.text: The hotel is sold as an adults-only property.
facts.excerpt: Paradisus Los Cabos - Adults Only is a pet-friendly hotel

facts.text: The adults program is for guests over 18 years of age.
facts.excerpt: Adults Only Experience (+18)

facts.text: The resort has direct access to the beach.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to the beach

facts.text: The resort features traditional mission-style architecture, works of art and touches inspired by local culture.
facts.excerpt: Witness traditional mission-style architecture, works of art and special touches inspired by the local culture.

facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: Hotel member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

facts.text: Stays are all-inclusive.
facts.excerpt: All of this, embraced by our luxurious All Inclusive.

facts.text: Destination Inclusive experiences are available to guests at no extra cost.
facts.excerpt: Our Destination Inclusive® experience is available to guests at no extra cost

facts.text: The cuisine includes traditional Mexican dishes inspired by the sea and prepared with locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Savor deliciously prepared traditional Mexican cuisine inspired by the sea, prepared with locally sourced ingredients.

facts.text: SAL Steak Cave is a steakhouse that is not included in the all-inclusive plan.
facts.excerpt: In a cozy atmosphere, you can pair your dishes with mixology cocktails or a glass of wine. Not included in the all-inclusive plan.

facts.text: SAL Steak Cave has a formal dress code.
facts.excerpt: Formal

facts.text: At Tokimeku, sushi is served in western and Asian style, in a private dining room, on a Zen terrace or at the sushi counter.
facts.excerpt: Sushi is served in both western and Asian style and can be enjoyed in different spaces, such as a private dining room, a Zen terrace or the sushi counter.

facts.text: Cappella is an open-air a la carte Italian restaurant serving home-made pasta, wood-fired pizza and fresh salads.
facts.excerpt: The best of rustic Italian cuisine in this open-air a la carte restaurant. Enjoy the most traditional home-made pasta, wood-fired pizza and fresh salads.

facts.text: Santé overlooks the Sea of Cortez, and its breakfast and lunch are exclusive to The Reserve guests.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Sea of Cortez, Santé offers everything from delicious salads to textures, traditional flavors, and accents from all the latest culinary trends. Breakfast and lunch are exclusive for The Reserve guests.

facts.text: Cielo serves contemporary Mexican cuisine and traditional dishes with a modern influence.
facts.excerpt: Savor the authentic flavors of contemporary Mexican cuisine and a selection of traditional dishes with a modern influence.

facts.text: Agua Marina is a beachfront restaurant for open-air meals with sea views.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to the delicious specialties in this relaxed beachfront setting. A perfect mixture of avant-garde and international flavors to enjoy an open-air meal with views of the sea.

facts.text: Twe12lvet is an ice cream parlor with up to twelve flavors.
facts.excerpt: Discover a truly refreshing experience in our ice cream parlor with up to twelve flavors and different ingredients.

facts.text: Celsius is a pool bar where guests can have a drink without leaving the water.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy your drink without leaving the water. This pool bar is the perfect place to enjoy a drink in the Los Cabos sunshine.

facts.text: YHI Spa has individual cabins, couples cabins, a sauna, a leisure pool, a beauty salon, a relaxation area and a fully equipped gym.
facts.excerpt: It consists of four individual cabins, two cabins for couples, a sauna and a leisure pool. In addition to a beauty salon, relaxation area and a fully equipped gym.

facts.text: YHI Spa treatments are made with local ingredients and essential oils.
facts.excerpt: pamper yourself with treatments made with local ingredients and essential oils

facts.text: YHI Spa packages include desert harmony and Baja Sur treatments and Fuego, a massage and facial for couples.
facts.excerpt: desert harmony (scrub, body wrap, detoxifying facial), Baja Sur (exfoliation and body wrap, massage and express pedicure) and Fuego (massage and facial for couples)

facts.text: YHI Spa is certified by the Wellness for Cancer organization to provide personalized wellness services to people with cancer.
facts.excerpt: YHI Spa in Los Cabos is certified by the prestigious Wellness for Cancer organization to provide personalized wellness services to people suffering from cancer.

facts.text: The Reserve Lounge offers The Reserve guests private check-in and check-out.
facts.excerpt: in The Reserve Lounge—with private check-in and check-out

facts.text: The Reserve Suite Swim Up King has direct access to a private pool.
facts.excerpt: A luxurious suite with direct access to a private pool and all the exclusive benefits of The Reserve.

facts.text: The Reserve guests get a welcome cocktail and a complimentary bottle of their favorite alcoholic beverage.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy privileged access to The Reserve Lounge and a special welcome cocktail and complimentary bottle of your favorite alcoholic beverage.

facts.text: The Reserve guests get an aromatherapy menu with turndown service every evening.
facts.excerpt: Nothing is more relaxing than an exclusive aromatherapy menu with turndown service every evening, while your personal Concierge assists you.

facts.text: The Reserve guests have a special area by the main pool.
facts.excerpt: feel free to relax and unwind in a special area by the main pool

facts.text: The Reserve guests have an exclusive offsite activity: a chocolate factory tour and a walk through San José del Cabo's old town.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive activity for The Reserve guests consisting of a tour of a chocolate factory and a walk through the old town.

facts.text: The Junior Suite Ocean View has a private terrace and a bathroom with a rain shower.
facts.excerpt: Gaze out at the subtle blue of the sea from the private terrace. Enjoy a complete room with two single beds, a lounge area with a sofa bed, and a bathroom with a rain shower.

facts.text: Junior Suites have local, organic minibar items.
facts.excerpt: Local, organic minibar items

facts.text: Activities include Latin dance, sushi, art and mixology classes plus wine and cheese and tequila and mezcal tastings.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy life-enriching activities such as Latin dance classes, sushi classes, art classes, wine and cheese tasting, tequila and mezcal tasting, and mixology classes.

facts.text: Evenings bring live music, resident DJs and theme parties.
facts.excerpt: And, in the evening enjoy the live music, resident DJs and theme parties.

facts.text: Sound healing sessions with bowls are held by the sea or in the gardens.
facts.excerpt: In natural settings, by the sea or in one of our gardens, let yourself be carried away by the sounds of the bowls

facts.text: Movie nights are held outdoors in the resort's gardens.
facts.excerpt: Relax under the starry sky during a movie session in our gardens.

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly; a stay with a dog is booked by adding the extra pet-friendly service.
facts.excerpt: To book a stay with your dog, please go to the booking process, choose your room category, rate, and add the extra pet friendly service.

facts.text: The resort has earned the title of Queer Destinations Committed Hotel.
facts.excerpt: The resort has earned the title of Queer Destinations Committed Hotel.

facts.text: The resort has a heated pool.
facts.excerpt: Heated pool

facts.text: The resort offers personalized butler service.
facts.excerpt: Personalized Butler Service

facts.text: Kanna Beach Club is a bar on the sand with views of the Sea of Cortez.
facts.excerpt: The soft golden sand under your feet, views of the calm, blue sea of Cortez, and a cold and refreshing cocktail in your hand.

facts.text: Destination Inclusive is presented as an experience unlike any other.
facts.excerpt: Prepare for an experience unlike any other.
